The '''jungle X-hopper''', nicknamed the '''mini-rig''', was a custom-designed compact [[starship]] created by [[Rose Tico]] and the [[Resistance]]'s [[Engineering Corps]] from surplus found in a [[New Republic]] depot. Its [[cockpit]] was from a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|T-65 X-wing]], fitted with [[repulsor coil]]s, [[Engine|thrusters]], and [[steering vane]]s. The X-hopper assisted with traffic control at the Resistance's [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]], guiding ships in and out of the [[jungle]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
